targets="10.35.0.10 10.35.0.11 10.35.0.12 10.35.0.13 10.10.0.11"

  echo "Scanning $ip..."

    for port in 22 80 443 3306 5432 8080 8443 9000 9090; do
      timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" 2>/dev/null && echo "$ip:$port open"
    done
  fi
done
